docs.title: Agna
docs.text:
Net-Mender

Town Goa Harbour Where Fishers' Coves Role Craftsman Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Blunt, wry and tireless; she has an opinion about everyone's knots.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Agna has mended the coves' nets for fifty years and remembers when the sea was calm enough to fish at night. Lately she finds nets torn by something with teeth far bigger than any fish she knows.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Sorcha: daughter

docs.title: Ailsa
docs.text:
Keeper of the Tide Book

Town Goa Harbour Where Wardens' House Role Scholar Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Precise, dry and quietly delighted by patterns; she can recite a tide from forty years ago.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ailsa keeps the great Tide Book, where the wardens have written down every tide since the first camp on the shore. Lately the new pages do not match the old ones as well as they should, and she is trying to work out why before she says so out loud.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Varro: old colleague
  • Halvard: friend

docs.title: Arlo
docs.text:
Son of the First Warden

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Serious, curious and stubborn; he asks why until the grown-ups give up.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Arlo is Iska and Dunmor's son and wants to be a sea warden like his mother and grandmother. He sneaks onto the quay at dawn to watch Varro read the water.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: mother
  • Dunmor: father
  • Ysmay: grandmother
  • Varro: patient teacher
  • Eilidh: best friend

docs.title: Bethoc
docs.text:
Keeper of the Gap Inn

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Service Age Adult Sells Hot stew, ale and rooms for the night

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Warm, quick-witted and unshockable; she has heard every sailor's story twice.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bethoc runs the Gap Inn, where sailors, hunters and travellers end up sooner or later. She keeps a board of monster sightings on the wall, and the hunters check it every morning.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Cormac: regular
  • Mhairi: fiddler
  • Brodie: sweetheart

docs.title: Brigid
docs.text:
Herb Gatherer

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Healer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Shy, gentle and observant; she notices everything and says very little.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Brigid gathers sea-herbs on the rocks for Elspeth at low tide. Some of the herb beds she has picked all her life have started to wither, and she is afraid to tell Elspeth.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Elspeth: teacher

docs.title: Brodie
docs.text:
Fishmonger

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Sells Fresh fish, smoked fish and salted fish for the road

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sorcha: supplier
  • Bethoc: sweetheart

docs.title: Caddoc
docs.text:
Trapper

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Adventurer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grumbling, cautious and clever with his hands; he complains constantly and never quits.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Caddoc sets traps along the shore for the creatures that come out of the forest at night. Something keeps springing his biggest traps without being caught, and it is starting to bother him.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Torva: hunting partner
  • Greer: buyer

docs.title: Calder
docs.text:
Cove Fisher

Town Goa Harbour Where Fishers' Coves Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, patient and endlessly mending something; he hums old camp songs while he works.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Calder is the calm half of the best boat in the coves. He wants to build a bigger boat one day and race it around Veligor himself.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sorcha: wife
  • Eilidh: daughter
  • Ronan: son
  • Tamsin: friend

docs.title: Cormac
docs.text:
Shanty Singer

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Performer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Theatrical, sentimental and a shameless flatterer; he cries at his own songs.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Cormac sings the old songs of the shared camp, where Savage hunters and Magicians first fished the inlet together. He swears he knows a verse about the gap that nobody else remembers, and that it is important.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bethoc: landlady
  • Mhairi: pupil

docs.title: Corrie
docs.text:
Apprentice Pilot

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Careful, earnest and anxious to get everything right; she writes notes on the back of her hand.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Corrie is Kor's apprentice and learns more from his mistakes than his advice. Last month she saw something large and dark pass beneath a ship in the gap, and nobody has believed her yet.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Kor: mentor
  • Esk: friend

docs.title: Dougal
docs.text:
Night Watchman of the Quay

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Guard Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sleepy-looking but sharp-eared; he tells terrible jokes to keep himself awake.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dougal has walked the quay at night for thirty years, counting lanterns and boats. He has started finding wet, clawed tracks on the lowest steps some mornings and has told only Ruan.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Ruan: friend

docs.title: Dunmor
docs.text:
Lamplighter of the Quays

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gentle, unhurried and content; he knows every lantern on the quay by its flicker.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dunmor lights and tends the quay lanterns each evening and is married to Iska. He is the one person who can make the First Warden sit down and eat.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: wife
  • Arlo: son
  • Gunna: lantern-maker

docs.title: Eilidh
docs.text:
Fisher's Daughter

Town Goa Harbour Where Fishers' Coves Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bossy, clever and impossible to fool; she keeps her little brother in line.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Eilidh can already gut a fish faster than most grown-ups. She wants to be a sea warden and practises reading the tide from the cove rocks every evening.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sorcha: mother
  • Calder: father
  • Ronan: brother
  • Arlo: best friend

docs.title: Elspeth
docs.text:
Healer

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Healer Age Elder Sells Sea-herb salves, poultices and tonics

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Serene, firm and quietly funny; she scolds her patients and then tucks them in.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Elspeth keeps the sea-herb remedies that the Magicians of the first camp brought to the shore. Since the hunters started bringing in so many wounds, she can barely gather herbs fast enough.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Osric: son
  • Brigid: apprentice
  • Torva: patient

docs.title: Esk
docs.text:
Sellsword of the Wild Coast

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Adventurer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, wary and courteous; she pays her debts and keeps her past to herself.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Esk came to Goa Harbour on a trading ship a few years ago and stayed to hunt monsters for whoever pays. She sails with fishing boats that go far out, and she has seen things in the deep water that she will only describe to Corrie.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Gwenna: friend
  • Teague: hopeful employer
  • Corrie: friend

docs.title: Fionn
docs.text:
Stair Runner

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quick, cheeky and fearless; he knows every shortcut on the cliffs.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Fionn runs messages up and down the cliff stairs for a copper a trip. He follows the hunters to the edge of the forest whenever he can and thinks nobody has noticed.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hamish: uncle
  • Torva: unfooled watcher

docs.title: Iska
docs.text:
First Warden

Town Goa Harbour Where Wardens' House Role Ruler Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quick, sure and hard to rattle; she reads people the way she reads the tide and rarely wastes a word.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: The other sea wardens chose her as First Warden because no pilot alive knows the inlet better. Every summer she skippers Goa Harbour's boat in the race around Veligor, and she has lost to Bain Harbour's crew by a single length more times than she likes to admit.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dunmor: husband
  • Arlo: son
  • Ysmay: mother
  • Varro: mentor
  • Nessa: friendly rival
  • Halvard: clerk
  • Kor: hopeful crewman
  • Ruan: trusted captain
  • Tamsin: boatwright
  • Jory: crewman
  • Quenna: rival racer and friend

docs.title: Gorm
docs.text:
Master of the Stairs

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Stubborn, proud and secretly sentimental; he talks about stone the way others talk about family.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gorm leads the builders who carve and mend the stairways and rope bridges that climb the cliffs. He wants to cut a new stair down to the far cove before the summer race, and he is behind.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ulric: mentor
  • Kestra: builder
  • Hamish: friendly rival

docs.title: Greer
docs.text:
Fur Trader

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Sells Furs, pelts, fur-lined cloaks and hoods

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Caddoc: supplier
  • Morag: friendly competitor

docs.title: Ysmay
docs.text:
Retired Sea Warden

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Resident Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sharp as a hook and twice as stubborn; she watches the inlet from her window and criticises every pilot.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ysmay was a sea warden for forty years and is Iska's mother. She never wanted to be First Warden herself and is fiercely proud that her daughter is.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: daughter
  • Arlo: grandson
  • Varro: old friend

docs.title: Gunna
docs.text:
Master Lantern-Maker

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Craftsman Age Elder Sells Quay lanterns, hand lanterns and storm lanterns

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Calm, mysterious and gently teasing; she answers questions with questions.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gunna makes the forest-crafted lanterns that light Goa Harbour's quays at night, using a craft handed down from the Magicians of the first camp. She is looking for an apprentice worthy of her oldest secrets.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tarran: apprentice
  • Dunmor: lamplighter

docs.title: Gwenna
docs.text:
Outfitter

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Sells Rope, grappling hooks, torches, waxed cloaks and travel food

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lachlan: pestering customer
  • Esk: friend

docs.title: Haldor
docs.text:
Head of the Timber Crews

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Big, careful and soft-spoken; he thanks every tree before it falls.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Haldor leads the crews that cut timber where the forest meets the shore and float it round to the quay. He has had to pull his crews back from the deeper woods twice this year because of monsters.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Merrin: cutter
  • Osric: woodsman
  • Tamsin: demanding customer

docs.title: Halvard
docs.text:
Clerk of the Wardens' House

Town Goa Harbour Where Wardens' House Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fussy, orderly and kind underneath; he cannot leave a crooked ledger alone.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Halvard records every ship that comes through the gap and every pilot who brings it in. He came from a farming valley inland and still gets seasick standing on the quay.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: employer
  • Ailsa: friend

docs.title: Hamish
docs.text:
Rope-Lift Keeper

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Chatty, jolly and nosy; he knows everyone's business because everyone rides his lift.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hamish works the rope lift that hauls goods and tired legs from the quay to the top of the cliffs. He dreams of building a second lift, if only Gorm would stop calling lifts lazy.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Gorm: friendly rival
  • Fionn: nephew

docs.title: Jory
docs.text:
Race Crew

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Loud, loyal and tireless; he would row around Veligor alone if Iska asked him to.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Jory crewed the Gap Runner for the first time last summer and talks about nothing else. He works the quay the rest of the year, hauling timber and wool onto ships.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: skipper
  • Tamsin: boss

docs.title: Kenna
docs.text:
Young Hunter

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Adventurer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Restless, proud and quick to anger, but fiercely loyal to her friends.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Kenna is Torva's newest hunter and wants to bring down something big enough to be talked about at the Gap Inn. She still has not forgiven Merrin for a race they ran when they were nine.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Merrin: rival
  • Torva: mentor

docs.title: Kestra
docs.text:
Rope-Bridge Builder

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fearless, light-footed and impatient with anyone who looks down.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Kestra strings the rope bridges between the cliff houses and can cross any of them blindfold. Something has been chewing the ropes on the highest bridge, and she means to catch it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Gorm: master builder
  • Tarran: sweetheart

docs.title: Lachlan
docs.text:
Adventurer

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Adventurer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bright, boastful and generous; he makes friends in minutes and plans in seconds.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lachlan grew up in the coves and wants to be the first to map the sea caves under the cliffs. He keeps asking Gwenna for her old maps, and she keeps saying no.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ronan: admirer
  • Gwenna: reluctant advisor

docs.title: Merrin
docs.text:
Timber Cutter

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fast, proud and competitive; she keeps a running tally of who has felled the most.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Merrin is the youngest cutter on Haldor's crew and wants to prove she can run a crew of her own. She and Kenna have been rivals since they were children.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Haldor: crew head
  • Kenna: rival

docs.title: Mhairi
docs.text:
Fiddler

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Mischievous, bright and tireless; she plays faster when people try to stop dancing.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mhairi plays at the Gap Inn and at the summer race send-off. She is writing a song about the race and needs Goa Harbour to win so she can finish it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bethoc: employer
  • Cormac: old mentor

docs.title: Moira
docs.text:
Cliff Watch Guard

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Guard Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bold, restless and always the first to volunteer; she climbs the stairs two at a time for fun.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Moira joined the watch to see a monster up close and has now seen far more than she wanted. She would still rather be out with the hunters on the wild coast.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ruan: captain
  • Torva: friend

docs.title: Morag
docs.text:
Wool Trader

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Sells Highland wool, knitted jumpers, blankets and sea-mittens

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Greer: friendly competitor
  • Teague: drover

docs.title: Osric
docs.text:
Woodsman

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Uneasy, watchful and superstitious; he will not work past sunset for any wage.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Osric was cutting alone deep in the forest last autumn when every bird went silent at once. He has not been back there, and he will not say what he saw.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Haldor: crew head
  • Elspeth: mother

docs.title: Ronan
docs.text:
Fisher's Son

Town Goa Harbour Where Fishers' Coves Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dreamy, curious and always wandering off; he collects shells, feathers and anything that glows.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ronan found a strange smooth stone in a tide pool that he keeps hidden in his pocket. He wants to go with the adventurers to the sea caves, which nobody will allow.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sorcha: mother
  • Calder: father
  • Eilidh: sister
  • Lachlan: hero

docs.title: Ruan
docs.text:
Captain of the Cliff Watch

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Steady, broad-shouldered and few-worded; he trusts a good rope more than a good speech.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ruan leads the small watch that guards the cliff stairs and the paths down from the forest. Since the Disturbance began, creatures have started climbing the cliffs at night, and he wants more lanterns on the high landings.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Moira: guard
  • Dougal: friend
  • Iska: First Warden

docs.title: Sorcha
docs.text:
Cove Fisher

Town Goa Harbour Where Fishers' Coves Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Loud, warm and practical; she runs her boat and her family the same way, with a lot of shouting and a lot of love.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Sorcha fishes the coves with her husband Calder and has the best catch of any boat in the town. She has stopped taking her children out past the point since the sea turned rougher.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Calder: husband
  • Eilidh: daughter
  • Ronan: son
  • Agna: mother
  • Brodie: buyer

docs.title: Tamsin
docs.text:
Boatwright

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fierce, inventive and never satisfied; she rebuilds the race boat every winter whether it needs it or not.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tamsin builds and keeps Goa Harbour's race boat, the Gap Runner, and has sworn this is the summer it finally beats Bain Harbour. She wants timber from the deep forest, which is exactly where Haldor will not send his crews.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Calder: friend
  • Haldor: stubborn supplier
  • Iska: skipper
  • Jory: helper

docs.title: Tarran
docs.text:
Lantern-Maker's Apprentice

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Eager, clumsy and full of ideas; half of his lanterns are brilliant and half of them do not light.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tarran is Gunna's apprentice and is sure she is keeping the best part of the craft from him. He wants to make a lantern bright enough to drive monsters off the cliff landings.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Gunna: master
  • Kestra: sweetheart

docs.title: Teague
docs.text:
Highland Drover

Town Goa Harbour Where Lantern Market Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Easygoing, weathered and full of stories that grow with each telling.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Teague brings wool and pelts down from the highlands by the hill road to the coast. Monsters on that road cost him half a flock last spring, and he is looking for brave company for the next trip.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Morag: employer
  • Esk: possible guard

docs.title: Torva
docs.text:
Hunter of the Wild Coast

Town Goa Harbour Where Forest Shore Role Adventurer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cool, scarred and dryly funny; she never boasts and never misses.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Torva leads the hunters who keep the monsters of the wild coast away from the town's paths and timber crews. Each year there are more of them and they come closer, and she wants to know why.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Moira: admirer
  • Caddoc: hunting partner
  • Kenna: apprentice
  • Elspeth: healer
  • Fionn: secret follower

docs.title: Ulric
docs.text:
Stonecarver

Town Goa Harbour Where Cliff Stairs Role Craftsman Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Slow, thoughtful and kind; he carves a little animal into every step he cuts.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ulric taught Gorm everything about stone and still carves the hardest steps himself. He hopes someone will notice that his little carvings, read from top to bottom, tell the story of the first camp.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Gorm: pupil

docs.title: Kor
docs.text:
Sea Warden

Town Goa Harbour Where Inlet Quay Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cheerful and a little reckless; he whistles while he pilots and swears the tide likes him.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Kor became a full warden only last spring and already takes more ships through the gap than anyone. He secretly hopes Iska will pick him for the race crew this summer.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Corrie: apprentice
  • Iska: First Warden

docs.title: Nessa
docs.text:
Sea Warden

Town Goa Harbour Where Wardens' House Role Council Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sharp-tongued, funny and fiercely competitive; she argues every point at the Wardens' table and then buys the first round.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Nessa was the other name spoken when the wardens chose their First Warden, and she backed Iska herself in the end. She wants the wardens to train more young pilots before the rougher seas of recent years catch them short-handed.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: friend and fellow warden
  • Varro: old teacher

docs.title: Varro
docs.text:
Eldest of the Sea Wardens

Town Goa Harbour Where Wardens' House Role Council Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gruff, patient and slow to praise; he still walks the quay at dawn to watch the water before anyone else is up.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Varro taught Iska to pilot when she was barely tall enough to see over a gunwale. His knees no longer let him take ships through the gap, but the wardens still bring him every hard question about the tides.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Iska: pupil
  • Nessa: former pupil
  • Arlo: eager shadow
  • Ysmay: old friend
  • Ailsa: old colleague

docs.title: People of Kaldemor
docs.text:
The 40 people of Kaldemor in the game's first release.

Name Role Tobin Mayor of Kaldemor Lia Town Guide Tam Would-be Warrior Nell Cloud Counter Pell Taxi Driver Mildred Town Clerk Rufus Town Crier Lottie Schoolteacher Jem Fiddler Bram Potion Seller Gareth Smith Rosa Baker Bess Herbalist Molly Innkeeper of the Sleepy Snail Hale Park Ranger Quill Drillmaster Ewan Clockkeeper Fen Mushroom House Fan Orin Retired Woodcutter Wren Orin's Wife Garrick The Climber Hob Miller Meg Snail Hunter Digby Gauntlet Hopeful Wilbur Farmer Elsie Dairy Farmer Dottie Shepherd Girl Clem Orchard Keeper Wilf Spore Gatherer Alfie Head of the Carpenters' Guild Archie Carpenter's Apprentice Bertie Mushroom House Shaper Daisy House Painter Mabel Potter Percy Wheelwright Winnie Weaver Ned Cobbler Old Marta Grocer Hilda Storage Keeper Hattie Beekeeper

docs.title: Alfie
docs.text:
Head of the Carpenters' Guild

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Careful, patient and proud of a square joint, he measures three times and cuts once. He hums when the work is going well and goes silent when it is not.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Alfie leads the town's carpenters and keeps the great treehouse and the clock tower stairs in good repair. While mending an old beam in the treehouse he found a carving nobody can explain, and he has told only Ewan about it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Archie: apprentice
  • Ewan: friend

docs.title: Archie
docs.text:
Carpenter's Apprentice

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Eager, careless and full of big ideas, he starts three things before finishing one. He is very good at saying sorry.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Archie is Alfie's apprentice and dreams of building a treehouse even taller than the great one. He cracked a rung on the clock tower ladder last spring and has been too afraid of Ewan to own up.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Alfie: master
  • Ewan: clockkeeper

docs.title: Bertie
docs.text:
Mushroom House Shaper

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Twinkly, unhurried and full of riddles, he treats every mushroom house like an old friend. He never measures; he says the mushroom tells him.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bertie hollows out the town's mushroom houses and fits them with doors, windows and new rooms as they grow each spring. He has been doing it for fifty years and lets young Fen carry his tools. His granddaughter Daisy paints the houses he shapes.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Daisy: granddaughter
  • Fen: little helper

docs.title: Bess
docs.text:
Herbalist

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market Role Healer Age Elder Sells Herbs, poultices and teas

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brisk, practical and fond of telling people they should have come sooner. She trusts a leaf over a potion every time.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bess is Bram's older sister and the town's healer, binding the cuts and bites that come back from the fields. She tells Bram that his potions are only herbs in a hurry, and he tells her that her teas are only potions that gave up. She has treated more snail nips this year than ever before.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Bram: younger brother

docs.title: Bram
docs.text:
Potion Seller

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market Role Merchant Age Adult Sells Potions In the game Bram

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Friendly to every customer and stubborn with everyone else, he can talk about cauldrons for an hour. He admits he is wrong about once a year.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bram keeps the potion stall at the far end of the Market and teaches brewing to anyone with the hands for it. Years ago he quarrelled with Rosa over a loaf, and he has missed her bread and her company ever since without saying so.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bess: older sister
  • Wilf: spore supplier
  • Rosa: estranged friend

docs.title: Clem
docs.text:
Orchard Keeper

Town Kaldemor Where Farms Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Shy, gentle and happiest up a ladder among the apples. He goes red whenever Lia waves.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Clem looks after the orchards between the farms and the woods, and Hattie's bees keep his blossoms busy every spring. Something has been gnawing the roots of the trees nearest the woods, and it is not a snail.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lia: sweetheart
  • Hattie: neighbour

docs.title: Daisy
docs.text:
House Painter

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Lively, messy and never seen without paint on her nose, she thinks no colour is too bright. She is cheerfully deaf to compliments.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Daisy paints the mushroom houses that her grandfather Bertie shapes, and half the shutters in Kaldemor. She has no idea that Jem has been writing her a song for a year, or she pretends not to.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bertie: grandfather
  • Jem: admirer

docs.title: Digby
docs.text:
Gauntlet Hopeful

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Adventurer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Earnest, clumsy and impossible to discourage, he gets up from every fall grinning. He believes hard work beats talent, and he has had to.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Digby was a farmhand for Wilbur until he decided to become a warrior, and he still helps with the harvest. He has failed Quill's hanging course eleven times and means to pass it before the leaves turn.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Wilbur: former employer
  • Quill: drillmaster
  • Meg: rival

docs.title: Dottie
docs.text:
Shepherd Girl

Town Kaldemor Where Farms Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Small, determined and very fond of her sheep, she counts them twice before bed. She does not like to be told she is too young for anything.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dottie minds her grandmother Elsie's sheep on the hills and sells their wool to Winnie the weaver. One of her lambs wandered toward the woods a week ago and has not come back, and she has not told her grandmother yet.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Elsie: grandmother
  • Winnie: weaver

docs.title: Elsie
docs.text:
Dairy Farmer

Town Kaldemor Where Farms Role Worker Age Elder Sells Milk, butter and cheese

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Proud, plain and up before the sun, she has a firm opinion about everything and a name for every cow. She does not believe in fuss.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Elsie keeps the dairy herd and makes the cheese that has fought Old Marta's pickles at the harvest fair for twenty years. Her cows will no longer graze the far pasture by the woods, and she has never known them to be wrong about anything.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dottie: granddaughter
  • Old Marta: old rival

docs.title: Ewan
docs.text:
Clockkeeper

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Worker Age Elder In the game Ewan

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fussy, gentle and proud, he talks to the clock as if it could hear him and listens to it as if it could answer. He cannot stand dust, or people touching things that swing.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ewan has kept the clock tower for forty years, winding, oiling and listening. When a Shroom carried off the great gear, it was the first time the clock had ever stopped, and he still checks the gear every morning to be sure it is there.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Alfie: friend
  • Tobin: old friend
  • Garrick: uninvited climber
  • Archie: nervous young neighbour

docs.title: Fen
docs.text:
Mushroom House Fan

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Child Age Child In the game Fen

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Wide-eyed and full of questions, she notices the small things everyone else walks past. She thinks every squirrel has a secret.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Fen loves the mushroom houses and measures them every spring to see how much they have grown. She carries flour for Rosa in exchange for buns and follows Bertie around his work, hoping he will let her fit a window one day.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rosa: kindly baker
  • Bertie: hero
  • Tam: friend
  • Nell: friend
  • Lottie: teacher

docs.title: Gareth
docs.text:
Smith

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Swords, shields and armour In the game Gareth

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Broad, quiet and proud of a clean edge, he talks more to his anvil than to people. He thinks every smith should start with copper.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gareth works the forge in the Market and sells blades to the young warriors heading out to the fields. He teaches smelting and the use of upgrade scrolls, and he has been asked for more swords this year than in the five before it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Percy: customer
  • Hilda: neighbour

docs.title: Garrick
docs.text:
The Climber

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Adventurer Age Adult In the game Garrick

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Easygoing, odd and fond of a good saying, he is happiest anywhere higher than everyone else. He thinks up is just a direction.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Garrick lives up on a ledge above the Park fountain, where fewer people ask him what he is doing. He teaches Rope Up to anyone who has climbed to the lookout on Kaldemor Hills, and he has climbed the clock tower more often than Ewan would like.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Ewan: exasperated clockkeeper

docs.title: Hale
docs.text:
Park Ranger

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Guard Age Adult In the game Hale

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, watchful and slow to worry, which makes it serious when he does. He says more with a nod than most people say in a speech.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hale looks after the park gate and the meadow beyond it, and pays a bounty to anyone who thins out the snails. He was the first to hear something huge settle in a hollow past the woods, and he kept it to himself until he knew what it was.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tobin: mayor
  • Meg: scout
  • Quill: old comrade

docs.title: Hattie
docs.text:
Beekeeper

Town Kaldemor Where Farms Sells Honey, beeswax and candles

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Wilbur: husband
  • Tam: son
  • Clem: neighbour

docs.title: Hilda
docs.text:
Storage Keeper

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market In the game Hilda

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Molly: sister
  • Gareth: neighbour

docs.title: Hob
docs.text:
Miller

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Easygoing and dusty from head to toe, he whistles along with the creak of the sails. He worries about the weather the way other people worry about money.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hob runs the windmills in the Park and grinds the flour for half the town, Rosa's oven first of all. He is Orin and Wren's son, and the only woodcutter's child in Kaldemor who never wanted to swing an axe.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Orin: father
  • Wren: mother
  • Mabel: wife
  • Nell: daughter
  • Rosa: best customer

docs.title: Jem
docs.text:
Fiddler

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cheerful, restless and always tapping a foot, he cannot sit through a conversation without humming. He makes up songs about whoever is listening.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Jem plays his fiddle in the square by day and at the Sleepy Snail by night, and no harvest dance in Kaldemor starts without him. He is writing a song for Daisy the painter and has been for a year, because it is never good enough.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Daisy: friend
  • Molly: innkeeper

docs.title: Lia
docs.text:
Town Guide

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Official Age Young In the game Lia

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bright, quick and endlessly patient with newcomers, she answers the same question for the tenth time as if it were the first. She always knows the latest news in town before anyone else.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lia meets every newcomer in the square and shows them the way to the Market, the Park and the fields beyond. She was the one who first spread word that the clock tower had stopped. She is courting Clem the orchard keeper and pretends nobody has noticed.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Clem: sweetheart
  • Tobin: mentor

docs.title: Lottie
docs.text:
Schoolteacher

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Scholar Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Kind, curious and a little scatterbrained, she loses her spectacles on her head several times a day. She never answers a child's question with "because".

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lottie teaches the town's children in a schoolroom up in the great treehouse. She collects every version of the one-seed story she can find, and lately the children ask her about the monsters on the roads and the old seal, and she is not sure what to tell them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Nell: pupil
  • Fen: pupil

docs.title: Mabel
docs.text:
Potter

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Pots, jugs and bowls

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Calm, practical and good with her hands, she can tell what a pot is for before it leaves the wheel. She laughs from the belly.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mabel throws the pots, jugs and bowls of Kaldemor, including the crocks Old Marta keeps her pickles in. She is married to Hob the miller and is Nell's mother, and she has long given up calling Nell in from the clouds.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hob: husband
  • Nell: daughter
  • Old Marta: customer

docs.title: Old Marta
docs.text:
Grocer

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market Sells Fresh produce, pickles and groceries In the game Old Marta

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Wilbur: supplier
  • Mabel: potter
  • Elsie: old rival

docs.title: Meg
docs.text:
Snail Hunter

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Adventurer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cocky, quick and brave a step past sensible, she keeps a running count of every snail she has beaten and adds a few. Underneath the boasting she cares a great deal about the farms.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Meg hunts the meadow for Hale's bounty and scouts the edge of the woods for him when he is busy. She has been out past the hills further than she has admitted to anyone, and she swears the ground shook under her feet.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hale: mentor
  • Digby: rival

docs.title: Mildred
docs.text:
Town Clerk

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Neat, dry and exact, she has never misspelled a name in the town ledger. Her rare smile is worth waiting for.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mildred keeps the town's ledgers, the mayor's letters and the list of every family in Kaldemor. She has counted the town more carefully than Tobin ever has, and she quietly worries about what will happen to Kaldemor on the day he decides to rest.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tobin: mayor
  • Rufus: town crier

docs.title: Molly
docs.text:
Innkeeper of the Sleepy Snail

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bustling, motherly and nosy in the nicest way, she knows every traveller's business before their soup is served. She cannot stand an empty plate.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Molly runs the Sleepy Snail, the inn at the edge of the Market where travellers stop before the eastern countryside. She sends guests with heavy packs to her sister Hilda. Fewer travellers come in from the east these days, and the ones who do arrive with stories she would rather not believe.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hilda: sister
  • Jem: fiddler

docs.title: Ned
docs.text:
Cobbler

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Elder Sells Boots and shoes

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grumpy, honest and very slow, he will tell you your boots are a disgrace before he mends them beautifully. He does not trust anything that was made in a hurry.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ned has made the boots of Kaldemor for fifty years and judges people by how they walk. He and Orin have been friends since they were boys and still argue about who won a race neither of them remembers.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Orin: oldest friend

docs.title: Nell
docs.text:
Cloud Counter

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Child Age Child In the game Nell

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dreamy and very serious about her counting, she shushes grown-ups who interrupt. She sees snails, carts and teapots in every cloud.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Nell spends whole afternoons lying on the square counting clouds, in the cap her grandmother Wren knitted for her. She keeps a tally of every cloud she has ever counted in a little book and will not say how big the number is.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hob: father
  • Mabel: mother
  • Orin: grandfather
  • Wren: grandmother
  • Tam: friend
  • Fen: friend
  • Lottie: teacher

docs.title: Orin
docs.text:
Retired Woodcutter

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Resident Age Elder In the game Orin

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Slow, warm and a little deaf, he tells the same stories over and over and enjoys them more each time. He still judges every tree he sees by how it would fall.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Orin felled trees for forty winters and now counts them from his bench in the Park. He says the treehouse was a sapling when his grandfather was a boy, and nobody has the heart to argue. He and Wren have been married for more than fifty years.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Wren: wife
  • Hob: son
  • Nell: granddaughter
  • Ned: oldest friend

docs.title: Pell
docs.text:
Taxi Driver

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Service Age Adult In the game Pell

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Steady and plain-spoken, he never hurries a fare and never misses one either. He has opinions about every road on Veligor.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Pell drives the Kaldemor cab from the stand by the signpost, between towns and never into the wilds. Lately he drives the Royal Road a little faster than he used to, and he will not say what ran at his cab last month, only that Percy had to mend the wheel.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Percy: wheelwright

docs.title: Percy
docs.text:
Wheelwright

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Methodical, gloomy in a comfortable way and secretly very kind, he expects every wheel to break and is glad when it does not.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Percy builds and mends the carts, barrows and the town cab. He has mended more broken wheels from the Royal Road this year than ever, and he does not like the marks on some of them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Pell: friend and customer
  • Gareth: smith

docs.title: Quill
docs.text:
Drillmaster

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Guard Age Adult In the game Quill

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Stern, clipped and fair, he barks orders but never mocks a fall. He believes footwork wins more fights than muscle.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Quill runs the Kaldemor Gauntlet in the Park, a three-stage course of a monster yard, a hanging course and a last stand. He drills the young warriors who mean to protect the fields, and he has more of them than ever. He pretends not to notice Tam watching every run.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Digby: recruit
  • Hale: old comrade
  • Tam: would-be pupil

docs.title: Rosa
docs.text:
Baker

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Market Role Merchant Age Adult Sells Bread, buns and her famous mushroom bread In the game Rosa

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Warm, floury and a born feeder, she calls everyone "dear" and saves the heel of the loaf for her friends. She is private about the things that matter most to her.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rosa bakes in the terrace oven her grandmother built, brick by brick, the year the clock tower was raised; it has not gone cold since. Her mushroom bread needs spores and a pinch of ground blue snail shell. She has never mended an old quarrel with Bram, and she wishes she had.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Wilf: spore supplier
  • Hob: miller
  • Bram: estranged friend
  • Tobin: regular customer
  • Fen: flour carrier

docs.title: Rufus
docs.text:
Town Crier

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Booming, jolly and impossible to ignore, he cannot say anything quietly, not even good morning. He loves a good announcement more than a good dinner.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rufus rings his handbell in the square every morning with the news, the fair days and the lost cats. These days more of his notices are road warnings, and he has started reading them a little more gently so as not to frighten the children.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Mildred: clerk who writes his notices

docs.title: Tam
docs.text:
Would-be Warrior

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Child Age Child In the game Tam

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bold, loud and only a little afraid of snails, he swings a stick at anything that looks like an enemy. He hates washing behind his ears.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tam is going to be a warrior when he grows up, and he tells everyone so. He hangs about the Park hoping Quill will let him run the Gauntlet, and Mayor Tobin has told him he could even be mayor one day, if he washes.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Wilbur: father
  • Hattie: mother
  • Tobin: kindly mayor
  • Quill: hero
  • Nell: friend
  • Fen: friend

docs.title: Tobin
docs.text:
Mayor of Kaldemor

Town Kaldemor Where Town Square Role Ruler Age Elder In the game Tobin

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Warm, chatty and proud of his town, with a story for every occasion and a joke about the snails for every other one. He knows every family by name and most of their grandparents too.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tobin has been mayor for thirty years and likes to say the great treehouse has outlived three mayors, himself included. Just under three hundred people live in Kaldemor, and he means to see every one of them safe. His current project is a new fence around the gardens, with ground snail shell mixed into the mortar.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lia: trusted guide
  • Mildred: clerk
  • Hale: ranger
  • Rosa: baker
  • Ewan: old friend
  • Tam: admirer
  • Quenna: trading partner

docs.title: Wilbur
docs.text:
Farmer

Town Kaldemor Where Farms Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Big, cheerful and stubborn as a turnip, he loves his fields and talks to his pumpkins. He takes the snails personally.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Wilbur grows pumpkins, turnips and beans on the biggest farm east of the square, and sells most of it to Old Marta. The snails ate his prize pumpkin the week before last year's fair, and he has sworn it will not happen again.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hattie: wife
  • Tam: son
  • Digby: former farmhand
  • Old Marta: grocer

docs.title: Wilf
docs.text:
Spore Gatherer

Town Kaldemor Where Farms Role Worker Age Adult Sells Mushroom spores and caps

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Wiry, wry and happiest in the damp, he knows every mushroom by smell. He grumbles about everything except mushrooms.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Wilf gathers mushroom spores for Rosa's bread and Bram's potions and grows a few caps behind his cottage. He has just come back from visiting his sister and found the Shrooms in the woods far bolder than before, too bold for him to gather alone.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rosa: customer
  • Bram: customer

docs.title: Winnie
docs.text:
Weaver

Town Kaldemor Where Workshops Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Wool, cloth and blankets

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Chatty, warm and always half-listening to her loom, she can weave and gossip at the same time. She keeps a scrap of every cloth she has made.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Winnie weaves the wool from Dottie's sheep into cloth and blankets and spins yarn for Wren's caps. She has noticed Dottie bringing less wool lately and suspects the girl is keeping a worry to herself.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dottie: wool supplier
  • Wren: friend

docs.title: Wren
docs.text:
Orin's Wife

Town Kaldemor Where Kaldemor Park Role Resident Age Elder In the game Wren

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gentle, patient and gently teasing, she never tires of Orin's stories, though she tells him when he is shouting. Her knitting needles are never still.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Wren knits caps for every child in Kaldemor, and some of them even wear them; her granddaughter Nell never takes hers off. She spends her afternoons in the Park beside Orin, because the Park is nicest in the afternoon.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Orin: husband
  • Hob: son
  • Nell: granddaughter
  • Winnie: friend

docs.title: People of Midbarium
docs.text:
The 25 people of Midbarium in the game's first release.

Name Role Hask The Old One Dorrek Chieftain of the Kragvar Sennu Chieftain of the Tolmach Tavi Chieftain of the Uskari Odda Chieftain of the Brenna Ulm Keeper of the Council Fire Thrun Drummer of the Gatherings Gorra Cistern Keeper Brakka Apprentice Mason Korrin Chieftain's Son Vosk Master of Bridges Mabbu Elder of the Camps Yarrek Goat Herder Kesh Young Goatherd Ennek Canyon Guide Zirra Bowyer Skarra Captain of the Trail Watch Bekk Trail Watch Scout Ketta Returned Adventurer Lessa Bonesetter Neffa Song Learner Ahvi Song-Keeper Imre Stargazer Harra Wool and Cheese Seller Corwell Keeper of the Trading Post

docs.title: Ahvi
docs.text:
Song-Keeper

Town Midbarium Where Brenna House Role Scholar Age Elder Family Brenna

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Soft-voiced, exact and gently stubborn; Ahvi corrects anyone who gets a chieftain's name wrong, however important they are.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ahvi keeps the long songs that name every chieftain and Old One back to the Age of Division, and was the sister of the late Old One Varra. Lately she has been troubled by an old verse about beasts growing wild before the Burning came, and she cannot decide whether to sing it at the next gathering.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Neffa: pupil
  • Odda: cousin
  • Imre: friend

docs.title: Bekk
docs.text:
Trail Watch Scout

Town Midbarium Where Uskari Rim Role Guard Age Young Family Uskari

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cocky, quick and kind to children, who follow him around in a small admiring crowd.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bekk is Skarra's son and the fastest climber on the rim. He wants to prove himself by tracking a beast that has been raiding the high pastures, and his mother has forbidden him to try it alone.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Skarra: mother
  • Korrin: admirer

docs.title: Brakka
docs.text:
Apprentice Mason

Town Midbarium Where Kragvar Quarter Role Craftsman Age Young Family Kragvar

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Eager, restless and quick with a chisel; Brakka would rather carve something new than mend something old.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Brakka is Dorrek's daughter and is learning the mason's trade from Vosk. She dreams of carving a new stairway down the cliff to the valley floor, the first new route in a hundred years, and has already sketched it on every flat stone she can find.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dorrek: father
  • Gorra: mother
  • Vosk: mentor

docs.title: Corwell
docs.text:
Keeper of the Trading Post

Town Midbarium Where Trading Post Sells Lowland goods, lamp oil, salt, tools and travel supplies

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Harra: friendly rival trader
  • Ennek: guide for hire
  • Imre: lodger

docs.title: Dorrek
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Kragvar

Town Midbarium Where Kragvar Quarter Role Ruler Age Adult Family Kragvar

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Blunt, broad-shouldered and stubborn as granite, but scrupulously fair once he has made up his mind.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dorrek was chosen chieftain when his uncle died in a rockfall, and he still climbs the highest scaffold himself before he lets any mason on it. He argued long in council for a Kragvar Old One, lost to the families' choice of Hask, and has stood by that decision without a word of complaint ever since.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Gorra: wife
  • Brakka: daughter
  • Korrin: son
  • Ulm: father
  • Vosk: cousin
  • Hask: respected chieftain

docs.title: Ennek
docs.text:
Canyon Guide

Town Midbarium Where Trading Post Role Service Age Young Family Tolmach

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Easygoing and confident, with a herder's eye for weather and a habit of whistling on dangerous ledges.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ennek is Sennu's son and leads traders and travelers up the old Tolmach paths, as his family has since the founding. A spring on the south path that has run for as long as anyone remembers has gone dry this summer, and Ennek has not yet told his mother.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sennu: mother
  • Kesh: cousin
  • Ketta: sweetheart
  • Corwell: employer

docs.title: Gorra
docs.text:
Cistern Keeper

Town Midbarium Where Terraces Role Worker Age Adult Family Kragvar

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brisk, practical and always counting; Gorra measures water the way merchants measure coin.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gorra keeps the stone cisterns that water the terraces and knows to the bucket how long the town can last in a dry year. One of the oldest cisterns has started losing water through a crack nobody can find, and she would quietly reward anyone who could track it down.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dorrek: husband
  • Brakka: daughter
  • Korrin: son
  • Yarrek: water-sharing neighbour

docs.title: Harra
docs.text:
Wool and Cheese Seller

Town Midbarium Where Trading Post Sells Wool, hides, goat cheese and travel rations

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Mabbu: mother
  • Sennu: sister
  • Yarrek: husband
  • Kesh: son
  • Corwell: friendly rival trader

docs.title: Imre
docs.text:
Stargazer

Town Midbarium Where Terraces Role Scholar Age Adult Family none

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dreamy, absent-minded and delighted by everything; Imre forgets meals but never forgets a star.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Imre came to Midbarium to study its famous night skies and stayed for the stars and the hospitality. Imre spends nights on the highest terrace charting the heavens and swapping star stories with the Brenna, and hopes one day to be invited to recite at a gathering.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ahvi: friend
  • Corwell: landlord

docs.title: Kesh
docs.text:
Young Goatherd

Town Midbarium Where Tolmach Camps Role Child Age Child Family Tolmach

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Chatty, curious and fearless; Kesh asks every traveler where they came from and what the road was like.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Kesh is Harra and Yarrek's son and is trusted with the kids of the herd, though not yet with the grown goats. He and Korrin have a secret lookout above the terraces where they watch for monsters and, so far, mostly see eagles.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Yarrek: father
  • Harra: mother
  • Ennek: cousin
  • Korrin: best friend

docs.title: Ketta
docs.text:
Returned Adventurer

Town Midbarium Where Uskari Rim Role Adventurer Age Young Family Uskari

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bright and talkative about everything except one subject, which makes her go suddenly quiet.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ketta left home to adventure across Veligor, like many young Uskari, and came back last spring with a new scar and a pack full of stories. She will happily tell any of them except what she saw in a deep canyon cave on her way home.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Zirra: teacher
  • Tavi: chieftain
  • Ennek: sweetheart

docs.title: Korrin
docs.text:
Chieftain's Son

Town Midbarium Where Terraces Role Child Age Child Family Kragvar

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bold, scabby-kneed and always climbing something he was told not to climb.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Korrin is Dorrek's youngest and spends his days scrambling between the terraces with his friend Kesh. He wants to join the Uskari on the trail watch when he grows up, which his Kragvar family finds very funny and slightly insulting.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dorrek: father
  • Gorra: mother
  • Ulm: grandfather
  • Kesh: best friend
  • Bekk: hero

docs.title: Lessa
docs.text:
Bonesetter

Town Midbarium Where Brenna House Role Healer Age Adult Family Brenna Sells Herbal salves, splints and highland remedies

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Calm in a crisis and fussy everywhere else; Lessa will set a broken leg without blinking and then complain about the mud on your boots.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lessa is Odda and Thrun's daughter and the best bonesetter in the highlands. She has treated more monster bites this year than in her first ten years of healing together, and she is running short of the highland herbs that grow only on the far slopes.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Odda: mother
  • Thrun: father
  • Neffa: daughter
  • Mabbu: grumbling patient

docs.title: Mabbu
docs.text:
Elder of the Camps

Town Midbarium Where Tolmach Camps Role Resident Age Elder Family Tolmach

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sharp-tongued, sharp-eyed and endlessly hospitable; she will scold a guest and feed them in the same breath.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mabbu is mother to Sennu and Harra and has walked every herding path in the highlands at least a hundred times. Her knees no longer let her follow the herds, so she keeps the home camp and remembers, out loud, every spring that ran in every dry year.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sennu: daughter
  • Harra: daughter
  • Lessa: healer

docs.title: Neffa
docs.text:
Song Learner

Town Midbarium Where Brenna House Role Child Age Child Family Brenna

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Solemn, serious and proud; Neffa practises the long songs under her breath all day long.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Neffa is Lessa's daughter and is learning the long song of the Old Ones from Ahvi. Her great wish is to recite the whole song at a gathering without a single mistake before she turns twelve.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lessa: mother
  • Odda: grandmother
  • Ahvi: teacher

docs.title: Odda
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Brenna

Town Midbarium Where Brenna House Role Ruler Age Elder Family Brenna

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Warm, shrewd and endlessly calm; Odda can settle a quarrel between two chieftains with one well-chosen story.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Odda leads the Brenna, who host every choosing, and she hosted the one that named Hask after Old One Varra died. She keeps up an old friendship in Fairy Forest from her envoy days and still writes letters there each spring.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Thrun: husband
  • Lessa: daughter
  • Neffa: granddaughter
  • Ahvi: cousin
  • Hask: friend
  • Calyra: old friend

docs.title: Hask
docs.text:
The Old One

Town Midbarium Where Great Hall Role Ruler Age Adult Family Uskari

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, patient and hard to rattle; Hask listens to a whole loud council without a word, then speaks once and plainly.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hask was born an Uskari and led the family as its chieftain until Old One Varra of the Brenna died and the four families chose Hask to follow her. Hask gave up the Uskari chieftainship that same night, as custom asks, and is one of the youngest Old Ones the Brenna songs name. Hask's private worry is that the canyon patrols are stretched thinner every season, and that the families are too proud to say so in council.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Zirra: older sister
  • Tavi: successor
  • Ulm: keeper of the fire and trusted counsel
  • Dorrek: blunt but loyal critic
  • Odda: host of the choosing and adviser

docs.title: Sennu
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Tolmach

Town Midbarium Where Tolmach Camps Role Ruler Age Adult Family Tolmach

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Weathered, wry and unhurried; Sennu has a herder's patience and a herder's habit of counting heads twice.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Sennu leads the Tolmach from a hide tent like any other herder, and moves the camps with the seasons as the family always has. This year Sennu has kept the herds closer to town than ever before because of the monsters in the low valleys, and the high pastures are starting to suffer for it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Mabbu: mother
  • Harra: sister
  • Ennek: son
  • Tavi: uneasy ally on the trails

docs.title: Skarra
docs.text:
Captain of the Trail Watch

Town Midbarium Where Uskari Rim Role Guard Age Adult Family Uskari

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Stern, watchful and dryly funny once the patrol is safely home.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Skarra commands the Uskari patrols that guard the highland trails and see travelers from camp to camp. She marks every monster sighting on a hide map in her tent, and the marks have been creeping closer to town each season.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tavi: friendly rival
  • Bekk: son

docs.title: Tavi
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Uskari

Town Midbarium Where Uskari Rim Role Ruler Age Adult Family Uskari

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Restless, direct and competitive; Tavi would rather walk the trail than talk about it, and hates losing at anything.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tavi left the rim as a young adventurer and spent a season training with the swordsmen of the capital before coming home to hunt. When Hask was chosen Old One, the Uskari chose Tavi to lead them, and Tavi has since doubled the trail patrols and still walks the worst stretch personally.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hask: former chieftain
  • Skarra: friendly rival
  • Ketta: worried-over hunter
  • Sennu: uneasy ally on the trails
  • Rhys: old training partner

docs.title: Thrun
docs.text:
Drummer of the Gatherings

Town Midbarium Where Great Hall Role Performer Age Elder Family Brenna

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Loud, warm and impossible to embarrass; Thrun laughs from the belly and drums the same way.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Thrun beats the great drum that calls the four families to every choosing and every feast. Thrun drummed for the choosing of Old One Hask and swears it was the finest night of drumming in a generation, though the drum's old hide has since split and needs replacing with the skin of a beast few hunters would dare to track.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Odda: wife
  • Lessa: daughter
  • Vosk: old friend

docs.title: Ulm
docs.text:
Keeper of the Council Fire

Town Midbarium Where Great Hall Role Official Age Elder Family Kragvar

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gruff, slow-moving and fiercely proud of his duty; he talks to the fire more kindly than to most people.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ulm has tended the fire in the great hall for forty years and has never once let it burn low. He knows every Kragvar song about the fighters who stayed beneath the World Tree, and lately he wonders aloud whether anyone down there still remembers the Kragvar.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dorrek: son
  • Korrin: grandson
  • Hask: the Old One he serves

docs.title: Vosk
docs.text:
Master of Bridges

Town Midbarium Where Kragvar Quarter Role Craftsman Age Elder Family Kragvar

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Careful, dry-humoured and suspicious of anything that sways; he trusts a knot only after he has tied it himself.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Vosk keeps every rope-and-plank bridge in Midbarium sound and has taught three generations of Kragvar how to splice a cable. Twice this season he has found ropes on the far canyon bridge gnawed half through in the night, and he does not know what is doing it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Brakka: apprentice
  • Dorrek: cousin
  • Thrun: old friend

docs.title: Yarrek
docs.text:
Goat Herder

Town Midbarium Where Tolmach Camps Role Worker Age Adult Family Tolmach

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gentle, slow to speak and devoted to his goats, each of which he knows by name.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Yarrek leads the family's goats between the high pastures and the camps. Last month three of his goats came back from the valley wild-eyed and biting, and he keeps them penned apart, hoping they will calm.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Harra: wife
  • Kesh: son
  • Gorra: water-sharing neighbour

docs.title: Zirra
docs.text:
Bowyer

Town Midbarium Where Uskari Rim Role Merchant Age Elder Family Uskari Sells Bows, arrows, climbing ropes and hunting knives

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Precise, sardonic and impossible to flatter; Zirra judges people by how they hold a bow.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Zirra is the Old One's older sister and makes the bows the Uskari hunt and patrol with. She teases Hask mercilessly in private and defends Hask fiercely to anyone else.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hask: younger brother
  • Ketta: former pupil
