docs.title: Agatha
docs.text:
River Fisher

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Tough, practical and cheerful in any weather. She can gut a fish and an argument in one stroke.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Agatha fishes the river with her father's old nets and sells the catch to her husband's stall in the Crown Market. Her nets have been coming up torn lately, and not by any fish she knows.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Silas: husband
  • Osmund: father
  • Robin: son

docs.title: Agnes
docs.text:
Palace Maid

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Service Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cheerful, nosy and quick on her feet. She hears everything and repeats only half of it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Agnes grew up in her father's kitchen and now cleans the upper halls. She has noticed the princess's boots are muddy every morning and has said nothing, yet.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Osbert: employer
  • Cuthbert: father

docs.title: Alaric
docs.text:
Young Prince

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Curious, chatty and always muddy. He asks why about everything and remembers every answer.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Alaric spends more time in the palace gardens and kitchens than in his lessons. He collects beetles, keys and rumours, and he is sure there is a secret passage behind the throne hall tapestries.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aveline: mother
  • Leofric: father
  • Elinor: sister
  • Godwin: gardening friend
  • Peterkin: friend

docs.title: Aldith
docs.text:
Herb Wife of the Riverside

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Healer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Earthy, warm and stubborn about old remedies. She swears by river mint for everything.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Aldith treats the riverside folk with herbs from her own garden, while her brother serves as the palace physician. They argue cheerfully about whose cures work best and secretly swap recipes.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ansel: brother
  • Edwina: old friend

docs.title: Aldous
docs.text:
Keeper of the Royal Vault

Town Selsior Where Royal Vault In the game Aldous

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Jocelyn: pupil
  • Gideon: old friend

docs.title: Alys
docs.text:
Cheesemonger

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Cheeses from every town and fresh butter

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Margery: daughter

docs.title: Ansel
docs.text:
Palace Physician

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Healer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Calm, gentle and slightly deaf. He treats a queen and a scullery boy with the same cold hands.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ansel studied healing at the Scholars' Quarter and has served the palace for decades. More guards come to him with claw wounds every season, and he keeps careful notes on what bit them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Aldith: sister

docs.title: Aubrey
docs.text:
Old Grand Swordmaster

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Wry, slow-moving and still frighteningly quick with a blade. He naps in the sun and wakes when a recruit holds a sword wrong.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Aubrey is the oldest Grand Swordmaster in the Guard and taught Rhys when Rhys was a recruit. He has spent his retirement searching old books for the Sword Saint's test, and he claims to have found a page of it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Rhys: former pupil

docs.title: Avice
docs.text:
Recruit

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fierce, proud and short with words. She trains harder when anyone is watching.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Avice walked to the capital from the highlands to try the Guard's trials, and she means to be the first of her year to earn the Swordsman's rank. She has noticed that the cloaked stranger who trains at dawn holds a sword like someone raised with fine manners.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rhys: captain
  • Pim: rival

docs.title: Aylwin
docs.text:
Road Patrol Guard

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brave, earnest and easily embarrassed. He writes poems he never shows anyone.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Aylwin rides with the road patrol and has already fought off a pack of wild boars on the road to Kaldemor. He is sweet on the princess, and she on him, and both of them think nobody knows.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Edric: lieutenant
  • Wystan: grandfather
  • Elinor: sweetheart

docs.title: Baldwin
docs.text:
Lamplighter

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Worker Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, unhurried and fond of the dark hours. He knows every lamp in the city by its flicker.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Baldwin lights the plaza lamps at dusk and walks the long way home through the old quarters lighting more. He has started leaving extra lamps burning near the city gate, just in case.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hugh: brother
  • Gilbert: supplier

docs.title: Bartholomew
docs.text:
Master of the Royal Academy

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grandfatherly, rambling and sharp as a tack beneath it. He answers questions with better questions.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bartholomew heads the Royal Academy, the school founded by the city's first Magicians. He welcomes students from every town and is proud that no two of them think alike.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Morwen: old friend
  • Thomasin: protegee

docs.title: Benedict
docs.text:
Head Librarian

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Hushed, fussy and passionately helpful. He can find any book except the one he lost himself.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Benedict keeps the Academy's great library and taught half the scribes in the palace. He has been searching for years for a missing volume of the Aristocrat war chronicles.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Petronella: former pupil
  • Ermengarde: sister

docs.title: Bennet
docs.text:
Boatwright

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Patient, wry and proud of his joinery. He can tell a boat's age by knocking on it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bennet builds and mends the river boats and barges. He is designing a faster barge for the river trade and needs someone brave enough to test it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Lucan: friend

docs.title: Bertrand
docs.text:
Drill Sergeant

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gruff, bellowing and fond of every recruit he shouts at. He has a voice that could crack a shield.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bertrand runs the dawn drills and swears he can turn anyone into a guard given a year and enough porridge. He keeps a list of every recruit he has trained and checks it against the patrol reports.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Pim: recruit
  • Helewise: wife

docs.title: Biscuit
docs.text:
Gate Dog

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Animal Age Adult In the game Biscuit

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Friendly, greedy and convinced every traveller has bread. He wags what he has of a tail at everyone.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Biscuit turned up at the gate one winter and the guards never managed to send him away. He sleeps by the gatehouse, follows his nose to the Crown Market every morning and comes back smelling of bread.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Maud: soft touch for scraps
  • Brann: keeper

docs.title: Brann
docs.text:
Gate Sergeant

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Guard Age Adult In the game Brann

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gruff, watchful and proud of his city. He welcomes everyone and trusts nobody until they have earned it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Brann commands the guards at the great gate and greets every traveller off the Royal Road. He likes to say the road is quiet, until it is not, and lately it is not more often than it used to be.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Biscuit: dog
  • Hollis: gate guard
  • Swithin: old colleague

docs.title: Cecily
docs.text:
Singer

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Shy off stage and fearless on it. Her voice is bigger than she is.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Cecily came from a fishing village on the coast and sings between the acts at the Gilded Stage. She is learning old ballads from a plaza singer and dreams of singing at a royal feast.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Fulke: teacher

docs.title: Clement
docs.text:
Royal Herald

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Nervous in private and magnificent on the steps. He rehearses every proclamation to the pigeons first.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Clement took over the herald's post when Gideon retired and still feels he is standing in a giant's boots. He climbs the ladder every week to ask the old man's advice and pretends it is only a social call.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Gideon: mentor

docs.title: Constance
docs.text:
Adventurer

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Adventurer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cool-headed, studious and dryly funny. She plans every fight and is annoyed when it does not go to plan.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Constance trained as a mage at the Academy before she chose the road over the classroom. She keeps her partner alive and keeps notes on every monster they fight, in case anyone ever wants to know why they changed.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Morwen: former teacher
  • Joan: landlady
  • Thurstan: adventuring partner

docs.title: Crispin
docs.text:
Playwright

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Anxious, witty and always scribbling. He talks in half-finished lines.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Crispin is writing a grand play about the Balrog War for the Gilded Stage, and he cannot decide how it should end. The historians tell him nobody knows what the Balrog truly is, which he finds very unhelpful.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lavinia: employer
  • Rosamund: wife
  • Marigold: daughter
  • Thomasin: history adviser

docs.title: Cuthbert
docs.text:
Royal Cook

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Loud, red-faced and generous. He shouts at the pots and sings to the bread.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Cuthbert cooks for the palace and for every envoy's feast, and he insists on learning each town's dishes properly. His dream is a great harvest feast with one dish from every town on a single table.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Osbert: employer
  • Agnes: daughter

docs.title: Dickon
docs.text:
Skywalk Carpenter

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fearless, cheerful and a little reckless. He whistles while hanging over thin air.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dickon builds and mends the skywalks that cross above the old quarters' streets. He wants to build one long enough to cross from the old quarters to Theatre Row without touching the ground.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Ida: wife

docs.title: Edith
docs.text:
Costumer

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Craftsman Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Thrifty, patient and full of pins. She can make a king's robe from curtains.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Edith sews every costume on Theatre Row from cloth she haggles out of the Crown Market. Her sister dresses the royal family, and the two of them trade gossip about who wore what.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Sybil: sister
  • Isabeau: supplier

docs.title: Edric
docs.text:
Lieutenant of the Road Patrol

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Weathered, plain-spoken and tired in a way sleep does not fix. He jokes to keep his patrols calm.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Edric leads the patrols that ride the royal roads between the towns. Every season there are more monsters and bolder ones, and he wants the Court to train faster than the wilds grow worse.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aylwin: patrol guard
  • Tristan: brother
  • Merrick: friend
  • Gervase: friend

docs.title: Edwina
docs.text:
Midwife

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Healer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Calm, blunt and unshockable. She has delivered half the old quarters and scolds them all.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Edwina has brought more babies into Selsior than anyone alive and treats the old quarters' cuts and fevers too. She keeps a list of every child she delivered and turns up at their weddings uninvited.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Aldith: old friend

docs.title: Elinor
docs.text:
Princess of Wonder Kingdom

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Resident Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bold, restless and stubborn as a mule. She hates embroidery and loves anything with a blade or a horse in it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Elinor sneaks out at dawn to take sword lessons at the Knights' Court under a borrowed cloak. She wants to pass the Guard's trials like anyone else, and she is terrified her parents will find out before she does.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aveline: mother
  • Leofric: father
  • Alaric: brother
  • Sybil: secret keeper
  • Aylwin: sweetheart
  • Rowena: secret teacher

docs.title: Emmeline
docs.text:
Flower Seller

Town Selsior Where Plaza Sells Flowers, garlands and festival ribbons

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Lambert: sweetheart

docs.title: Ermengarde
docs.text:
Bookbinder

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Craftsman Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Placid, careful and fond of terrible puns. She smells of glue and old leather.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ermengarde mends and binds the Academy's books in a tiny shop beside the library. She once found a letter sewn inside an old binding and has never told anyone what it said.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Benedict: brother

docs.title: Everard
docs.text:
Academy Student

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Lazy, charming and secretly brilliant. He sleeps through lectures and passes every exam.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Everard came to the Academy from a harbour town and spends more time on Theatre Row than in class. His teacher is convinced he could be a great mage if he tried, which is exactly what he is afraid of.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Morwen: teacher
  • Mariota: friend

docs.title: Fulke
docs.text:
Ballad Singer

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Charming, theatrical and a terrible liar. Every ballad he sings is mostly true.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Fulke plays the lute for Mirabel's dances and sings ballads of the Balrog War to anyone with a coin. He collects new songs from travellers at the gate and wants to write one that the whole kingdom sings.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Mirabel: dancer he plays for
  • Cecily: pupil

docs.title: Gervase
docs.text:
Cartographer

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Restless, chatty and allergic to blank spaces on maps. He paces when he thinks.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gervase draws the kingdom's maps and surveyed the royal roads alongside the queen's consort when they were both young. He is making a new map of where monsters have been seen, and it is getting crowded.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Leofric: old colleague
  • Edric: friend

docs.title: Gideon
docs.text:
Retired Herald

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Resident Age Elder In the game Gideon

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Booming, nostalgic and a little lonely. He laughs loudest at his own stories.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gideon cried the king's news in the plaza for forty years and now lives in a perch above the square, where he can hear every bell in Selsior. Nobody climbs the ladder to hear him any more, and he would dearly love a visitor.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aldous: old friend
  • Clement: pupil

docs.title: Gilbert
docs.text:
Candlemaker

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Candles, lamp oil and wax seals

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Mild, methodical and very fond of bees. He hums at the same pitch as his hives.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gilbert makes candles from his own beeswax on a rooftop above the old quarters. His bees have turned short-tempered this year, and he is not the only beekeeper who says so.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Baldwin: customer

docs.title: Godwin
docs.text:
Palace Gardener

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Worker Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Slow, patient and full of proverbs. He talks to his roses more than to people.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Godwin has tended the palace gardens since the old king's day. He grows a cutting from every town's favourite flower, and he worries that the wild bees have turned mean this year.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Alaric: gardening friend

docs.title: Gytha
docs.text:
Washerwoman

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Tough, sharp-tongued and quick to laugh. She can scrub a stain and a reputation clean.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Gytha runs the washing yard in a courtyard of the old quarters and knows every household's linen and secrets. She is raising her son with her parents' help and wants him to learn a trade, not a sword.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Simkin: father
  • Winifred: mother
  • Hodge: son

docs.title: Hamon
docs.text:
Keeper of the Gate Inn

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Hearty, nosy and a natural host. He greets guests by name on their second visit.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hamon runs the inn beside the gate, the first and last bed most travellers see in Selsior. He hears every road story first, and lately he keeps a board of them by the door for travellers to read.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Merrick: regular guest

docs.title: Hawise
docs.text:
Dyer

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bright, impulsive and stained to the elbows. She talks about colours the way others talk about friends.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hawise dyes cloth on the riverbank in vats of every colour, and her husband the miller complains the river runs purple on Tuesdays. She is trying to make a new colour for the cloth merchant's festival.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hereward: husband
  • Isabeau: cloth merchant

docs.title: Helewise
docs.text:
Guard Quartermaster

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Practical, thrifty and unshakeable. She knows how many arrows the Guard has to the last fletching.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Helewise feeds, arms and clothes the Royal Guard, and she haggles with the Crown Market's armourers as if the gold were her own. Patrols are wearing out boots faster than she can buy them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bertrand: husband
  • Vessa: armourer

docs.title: Hereward
docs.text:
Miller

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Flour, meal and bran

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Steady, dusty and slow to anger. He measures his words like flour.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hereward runs the great water mill that grinds flour for half the city. He would like the mill wheel rebuilt before winter and cannot afford it alone.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Hawise: wife

docs.title: Hodge
docs.text:
Lane Child

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Adventurous, sneaky and loyal to his friends. He climbs anything that holds still.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hodge runs wild across the rooftops and skywalks of the old quarters. He wants to join the Royal Guard, which his mother has forbidden, so he trains with a broom handle in secret.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Mab: friend
  • Wat: friend
  • Winifred: grandmother
  • Gytha: mother

docs.title: Hollis
docs.text:
Gate Guard

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Guard Age Young In the game Hollis

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Friendly, chatty and a little too fond of the view. He starts every greeting stern and ends it smiling.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hollis stands twelve hours a day at the gate and still likes looking out over the Royal Road. He warns travellers to mind the step, and the Sergeant.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Brann: sergeant
  • Tilda: friend

docs.title: Hugh
docs.text:
Warden of the Great Bell

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Guard Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Solemn, stubborn and proud of a duty most people forget. He polishes the bell's dais every morning.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hugh guards the Great Bell and tells anyone who asks that it rings only when a monarch is crowned, and for no one else. He has never admitted that on still evenings he sometimes thinks he hears it hum.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Mirabel: friend and sparring partner in argument
  • Baldwin: brother

docs.title: Ida
docs.text:
Night Watchwoman

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Watchful, dry and unafraid of the dark. She knows the old quarters by sound alone.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ida walks the old quarters' lanes each night for the Royal Guard, with a lantern and a stout stick. She has heard something scratching under the old drains that she cannot explain.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rhys: captain
  • Dickon: husband

docs.title: Isabeau
docs.text:
Cloth Merchant

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Highland wool, linen and dyed cloth

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Edith: customer
  • Hawise: dyer

docs.title: Jasper
docs.text:
Curio Dealer

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Urbanograd inventions, gadgets and curiosities

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Theobald: best customer
  • Robin: finder

docs.title: Joan
docs.text:
Keeper of the Crooked Lantern

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brisk, big-hearted and hard to fool. She runs her tavern like a ship and her lodgers like a family.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Joan keeps the Crooked Lantern, a tavern in the old quarters where adventurers rent rooms cheap. She grew up on her father's stories of the road and worries every time her lodgers head out of the gate.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Thurstan: lodger
  • Constance: lodger
  • Roland: father

docs.title: Jocelyn
docs.text:
Vault Clerk

Town Selsior Where Royal Vault Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brisk, organised and impatient with mess. She labels everything, including her lunch.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Jocelyn learned the vault's ledgers from Aldous and will one day take his desk. She has found an old record box with a missing key, and she cannot stop wondering what is in it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aldous: mentor
  • Wulfric: husband

docs.title: Kenric
docs.text:
Smith's Apprentice

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Earnest, sooty and a little clumsy outside the forge. He hums while he hammers.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Kenric works the bellows and the hammer for Selene and hopes to forge his first sword this winter. He looks after his little brother, whom the market warden once caught picking pockets.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Selene: master
  • Wat: brother

docs.title: Lambert
docs.text:
Street Juggler

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Showy, cheeky and kind to children. He never drops a ball unless it makes the crowd laugh.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lambert learned juggling from a puppeteer on Theatre Row and now draws the biggest crowds in the plaza. He wants to juggle for the queen at the next royal festival.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Emmeline: sweetheart
  • Rafe: teacher

docs.title: Lavinia
docs.text:
Mistress of the Gilded Stage

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Performer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grand, theatrical and ruthless about box-office takings. She treats every conversation as a performance.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lavinia owns the Gilded Stage, the oldest theatre on Theatre Row, and once played every great part in it. She wants one last triumph before she hands it on, and she has bet everything on a new play.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Crispin: playwright
  • Tibb: stagehand

docs.title: Leofric
docs.text:
Queen's Consort

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Council Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gentle, absent-minded and happiest with ink on his fingers. He forgets supper but never a road.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Leofric was a road surveyor before he married the queen, and he still keeps a great map of the royal roads on the palace wall. Each week he marks where the patrols met monsters, and he does not like how the marks are spreading.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aveline: wife
  • Elinor: daughter
  • Alaric: son
  • Gervase: old colleague

docs.title: Lettice
docs.text:
Rat Catcher

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cheerful, grubby and proud of her trade. She knows the old quarters' cellars better than anyone.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lettice clears rats from cellars and drains with her traps and her terrier. The rats in the old drains have grown bigger and bolder lately, and she has started charging double for the deep tunnels.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Tibb: sweetheart

docs.title: Lucan
docs.text:
Bargemaster

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Booming, sociable and fond of a wager. He knows every bend of the river and every tavern on it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lucan runs barges of grain, stone and timber up and down the river. River travel has become popular now that the roads are dangerous, and he cannot hire bargehands fast enough.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bennet: friend
  • Tristan: scout

docs.title: Mab
docs.text:
Pie Seller's Daughter

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bold, giggly and fearless. She tries every trick she sees the street performers do.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mab helps at her father's pie cart when she has to and practises cartwheels by the Great Bell when she can. She wants to be the most famous performer in Selsior.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Piers: father
  • Hodge: friend

docs.title: Margery
docs.text:
Baker

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Bread, buns and honey cakes baked the Kaldemor way

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Maud: friend
  • Alys: mother

docs.title: Marigold
docs.text:
Child Actor

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Precocious, dramatic and very sure of herself. She knows everyone's lines better than they do.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Marigold is the daughter of the playwright and the leading lady, and she has been on stage since she could walk. She wants a part in the new play and is not above blackmail to get it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rosamund: mother
  • Crispin: father

docs.title: Mariota
docs.text:
Academy Student

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bright, impatient and argumentative. She has opinions on everything and evidence for half of them.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mariota studies the stars and the old histories at the Academy and teases her brother at the Knights' Court for reading about swords instead of using them. She wants to be the first to explain why the monsters changed.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tobe: brother
  • Theobald: teacher
  • Everard: friend

docs.title: Maud
docs.text:
Housekeeper

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Role Service Age Adult In the game Maud

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bustling, bossy and warm. She shops like a general on campaign and expects the crowd to mind her baskets.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Maud keeps house for Dame Orsa and is at the market every dawn for eggs, bread and the best fruit in Selsior. She swears the market opens at dawn and closes only when the stalls run out, and she means to be there for both.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dame Orsa: employer
  • Biscuit: favourite dog
  • Margery: friend

docs.title: Melisende
docs.text:
Mistress of the Envoys' Hall

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Polished, patient and fluent in every town's manners. She never raises her voice and never loses an argument.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Melisende hosts the envoys every town keeps at the palace, and she knows which ones want highland tea, which want sea salt on their bread and which want the windows open. She advises the queen whenever two towns quarrel over trade.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aveline: queen she advises
  • Petronella: friend

docs.title: Merrick
docs.text:
Caravan Master

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Worker Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Loud, calculating and loyal to his crew. He prices danger like any other cargo.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Merrick leads trade caravans between the capital and the other towns. He is always looking for capable fighters to guard his wagons, and he pays well, because he has to.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hamon: innkeeper
  • Edric: friend

docs.title: Mirabel
docs.text:
Dancer

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Performer Age Young In the game Mirabel

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dreamy, light-hearted and impossible to hurry. She dances for the pleasure of it, and the coins are a bonus.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mirabel dances by the Great Bell every evening and swears she hears it sing at dusk when the wind is kind. The Bell Warden insists it has not rung since the coronation, and the two of them have argued about it, happily, for years.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hugh: friend and sparring partner in argument
  • Fulke: musician who plays for her

docs.title: Mirel
docs.text:
Apothecary

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Potions, tonics and cures In the game Mirel

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Prudence: rival
  • Rosalind: herb supplier

docs.title: Morwen
docs.text:
Teacher of Magic

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Intense, precise and impatient with showing off. She believes magic is mostly patience.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Morwen teaches young mages at the Academy and comes from an old Magician family. She studies the old seal-craft from the Balrog War in the hope that someone will one day need it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bartholomew: old friend
  • Everard: student
  • Constance: former student

docs.title: Dame Orsa
docs.text:
Shopkeeper

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Travel supplies, scrolls home and everything a traveller forgets In the game Dame Orsa

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Maud: housekeeper

docs.title: Osbert
docs.text:
Royal Steward

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Official Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Precise, dry and secretly sentimental. He can tell how many candles burned last night by sniffing the hall.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Osbert has run the palace household for more than thirty years and knows where every spoon and every secret is kept. He would like to retire, but he has not found anyone he trusts with the keys.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Aveline: queen he serves
  • Cuthbert: cook
  • Agnes: maid
  • Peterkin: page

docs.title: Osmund
docs.text:
Ferryman

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Worker Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Silent, weathered and wise about water. He speaks mostly in nods.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Osmund has poled the ferry across the river since he was a boy. He has seen things moving in the deep water that were not there before, and he no longer crosses after dark.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Agatha: daughter
  • Robin: grandson

docs.title: Percival
docs.text:
Leading Man

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dashing, pompous and a better actor than person, though he is working on it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Percival has played every hero on Theatre Row and wants to play the Savage warrior who held the Balrog at the Tree. He and Rosamund have quarrelled on and off stage for ten years, and audiences love it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Rosamund: rival

docs.title: Perrin
docs.text:
Royal Courier

Town Selsior Where Plaza Role Official Age Young In the game Perrin

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fast-talking, self-important and always in a hurry. Letters wait for no one, and neither does he.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Perrin carries the crown's letters to every town, to the highlands, the harbours and even the World Tree. He calls himself the fastest courier in the kingdom and has the blisters to prove it, though the monsters on the roads make him take the long way more often than he admits.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Tilda: cousin

docs.title: Peterkin
docs.text:
Palace Page

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Eager, breathless and proud of his uniform. He runs everywhere, even when nobody is waiting.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Peterkin carries messages inside the palace and dreams of becoming a royal courier one day. He practises by racing the clock tower bells from the cellars to the roof.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Osbert: employer
  • Alaric: friend

docs.title: Petronella
docs.text:
Royal Scribe

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Scholar Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Neat, serious and fond of long words. She corrects other people's spelling out of kindness.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Petronella copies every royal letter and decree into the palace books. She has the best handwriting in the kingdom and a secret ambition to write a history of her own.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Melisende: friend
  • Benedict: former teacher

docs.title: Piers
docs.text:
Pie Seller

Town Selsior Where Plaza Sells Meat pies, apple pasties and hot cider

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Mab: daughter

docs.title: Pim
docs.text:
Recruit

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Young In the game Pim

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Keen, clumsy and endlessly cheerful. He asks for one more round of drills even when he can barely stand.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Pim joined the Guard the day he was old enough and salutes everyone, just in case. Captain Rhys says his guard is full of holes, and Pim is determined to close every one of them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rhys: captain
  • Tobe: friend
  • Avice: rival
  • Bertrand: drill sergeant

docs.title: Prudence
docs.text:
Alchemist

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Alchemical reagents, inks and powders

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Methodical, prickly and proud. Her eyebrows have grown back twice.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Prudence brews reagents and inks for the Academy and insists her tonics are better than anything sold in the market. She is trying to brew a potion that heals in a moment, and her neighbours are trying to get her moved.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Mirel: rival

docs.title: Aveline
docs.text:
Queen of Wonder Kingdom

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Ruler Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Warm, quick to laugh and very hard to fool. She listens to everyone to the end, then decides in one sentence.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Crowned under the Great Bell, Aveline believes the crown's task is to keep the kingdom together, not to command it. She keeps a sworn alliance with Cavelor's Keeper of the Oath and trades long, argumentative letters with Urbanograd's Caller of the Open Table. Lately the reports of monsters on the royal roads keep her up at night.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Leofric: husband
  • Elinor: daughter
  • Alaric: son
  • Osbert: trusted steward
  • Melisende: adviser
  • Marrun: sworn ally
  • Rook: frequent correspondent

docs.title: Rafe
docs.text:
Puppeteer

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, clever and more expressive with his hands than his face. He speaks best through his puppets.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rafe runs a puppet show for the children of Theatre Row and taught the plaza's juggler his first tricks. His puppet Balrog is so frightening he has had to make it smaller twice.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Lambert: pupil

docs.title: Reynold
docs.text:
Warden of the Crown Market

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Harried, honest and allergic to shortcuts. He carries a set of weights and checks everyone's scales.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Reynold keeps order in the busiest market on Veligor, settling squabbles over stall space and short measures. He caught a pickpocket boy two summers ago and gave him a job instead of a cell.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Wat: errand boy

docs.title: Rhys
docs.text:
Captain of the Royal Guard

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Adult In the game Rhys

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Steady, demanding and fair. He believes a sword is only as good as the arm behind it, and says so often.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rhys trains the Guard's warriors in the Swordsman's way and sets the trials for every rank on the road to Swordmaster and beyond. In his youth he trained alongside an Uskari warrior of Midbarium, and he still says no one ever pushed him harder. Since the Age of Disturbance began he has more recruits than ever, and less time to make them ready.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Pim: recruit
  • Tobe: recruit
  • Avice: recruit
  • Rowena: fellow instructor
  • Aubrey: former teacher
  • Ida: night watch guard
  • Tavi: old training partner

docs.title: Robin
docs.text:
Mudlark

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Curious, muddy and full of treasure. He thinks every shiny thing is a lost crown.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Robin combs the riverbank at low water for things people have dropped, and sells the best to the curio dealer. He found an old badge with a seal no one recognises and keeps it under his pillow.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Jasper: buyer
  • Osmund: grandfather
  • Agatha: mother
  • Silas: father

docs.title: Roland
docs.text:
Retired Adventurer

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Adventurer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gravelly, boastful and kinder than he lets on. He has a scar for every story and a story for every scar.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Roland adventured across Veligor in his youth, when the wilds were far quieter than they are now. He sits in his daughter's tavern giving advice to young adventurers, and he wishes his knees would let him go with them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Joan: daughter
  • Thurstan: pupil

docs.title: Rosalind
docs.text:
Herb Seller

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Healing herbs, teas and seeds from Fairy Forest

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Mirel: customer

docs.title: Rosamund
docs.text:
Leading Lady

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Radiant, vain and fiercely loyal. She can cry on cue and laugh at herself off stage.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rosamund is the most famous actress in Selsior and the playwright's wife. She is determined to play the Magician who wove the seal in his new play, and she will not share the stage with Percival in it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Percival: rival
  • Crispin: husband
  • Marigold: daughter

docs.title: Rowena
docs.text:
Swordmaster of the Guard

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cool, precise and sparing with praise. When she smiles, recruits remember it for a week.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rowena earned the Swordmaster's rank young and teaches the Court's advanced classes. She agreed to give a cloaked stranger private lessons at dawn without asking her name, and she knows exactly whose daughter she is.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rhys: captain
  • Elinor: secret pupil

docs.title: Selene
docs.text:
Weaponsmith

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Swords, axes and blades from the capital's forges In the game Selene

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Vessa: sister
  • Kenric: apprentice

docs.title: Silas
docs.text:
Fishmonger

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Fresh fish from both harbours and smoked river eel

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Agatha: wife
  • Robin: son

docs.title: Simkin
docs.text:
Cobbler

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Craftsman Age Elder Sells Boots, shoes and repairs

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grumpy, chatty and soft at heart. He judges people by their soles.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Simkin has mended shoes in the same narrow lane for fifty years. Adventurers wear out their boots so fast these days that he has taken on more work than his old hands can manage.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Winifred: wife
  • Gytha: daughter

docs.title: Swithin
docs.text:
Gate Clerk

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Official Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fussy, precise and secretly romantic. He writes down every traveller and imagines their adventures.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Swithin records who comes and goes through the great gate, and has done since before Brann was a recruit. He has noticed that fewer travellers come in on foot these days, and more come in hurt.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Brann: old colleague

docs.title: Sybil
docs.text:
Royal Wardrobe Mistress

Town Selsior Where Palace Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Elegant, sharp-tongued and kind underneath. She can judge a person by their hem.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Sybil keeps the royal family's clothes, from the coronation robes to the princess's riding boots. She lent Elinor the cloak she wears to the Knights' Court and pretends she has no idea where it went.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Edith: sister
  • Elinor: mischief she covers for

docs.title: Theobald
docs.text:
Stargazer

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dreamy, nocturnal and absent-minded. He talks to the stars as if they owe him money.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Theobald watches the sky from a tower in the Scholars' Quarter and keeps charts going back sixty years. He buys every curious lens the market sells and is building a telescope larger than his tower.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Jasper: supplier of lenses
  • Mariota: student

docs.title: Thomasin
docs.text:
Historian of the Balrog War

Town Selsior Where Scholars' Quarter Role Scholar Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Earnest, careful and quick to say what nobody knows. She hates a good story that is not true.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Thomasin compares the four peoples' accounts of the Balrog War and refuses to call any one of them right. Lately she has been asked to lecture far more often, and she does not like why.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bartholomew: mentor
  • Crispin: friend

docs.title: Thurstan
docs.text:
Adventurer

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Adventurer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brash, brave and always hungry. He charges first and plans later.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Thurstan lodges at the Crooked Lantern and takes every bounty posted at the gate. He wants to make a name for himself before the Guard takes all the good monsters.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Joan: landlady
  • Constance: adventuring partner
  • Roland: mentor

docs.title: Tibb
docs.text:
Stagehand

Town Selsior Where Theatre Row Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Wiry, unflappable and sarcastic. He knows every trapdoor and rope in the theatre.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tibb works the ropes and trapdoors of the Gilded Stage and keeps the actors from killing each other. He is sweet on the Old Quarter's rat catcher and brings her the theatre's mice.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lavinia: employer
  • Lettice: sweetheart

docs.title: Tilda
docs.text:
Taxi Driver

Town Selsior Where Selsior Gate Role Service Age Adult In the game Tilda

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Breezy, practical and full of road wisdom. She never forgets a route once she has driven it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tilda drives the Selsior cab from the gate stand to any town with a taxi stand, though only to towns her passengers have walked to before. She never drives into the wilds, and lately she says that rule has never seemed wiser.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Perrin: cousin
  • Hollis: friend

docs.title: Tobe
docs.text:
Recruit

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Guard Age Young In the game Tobe

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Thoughtful, bookish and a little anxious. He knows the manual by heart and his arms do not.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tobe read every book on swordsmanship in the Scholars' Quarter before he came to the Court, and none of them mentioned how heavy swords are. He is still stuck on the third cut.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rhys: captain
  • Pim: friend
  • Mariota: sister

docs.title: Tristan
docs.text:
River Scout

Town Selsior Where Riverside Role Adventurer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, quick and confident on water and land. He would rather track a beast than fight it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Tristan scouts the river and its banks for the barges, warning them where creatures lurk. His brother leads the road patrol, and the two of them compare notes on how the wilds are changing.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Edric: brother
  • Lucan: employer

docs.title: Vessa
docs.text:
Armourer

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Sells Mail, helms and boots, fitted while you wait In the game Vessa

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Helewise: customer
  • Selene: sister

docs.title: Wat
docs.text:
Errand Boy

Town Selsior Where Crown Market Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quick, cheeky and sharper than he looks. He knows every alley shortcut in the city.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Wat used to pick pockets in the Crown Market until the warden caught him and gave him errands to run instead. He is honest now, mostly, but he still notices every purse that is badly tied.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Reynold: employer
  • Kenric: brother
  • Hodge: friend

docs.title: Winifred
docs.text:
Storyteller of the Old Quarter

Town Selsior Where Old Quarter Role Resident Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Twinkling, mischievous and endlessly patient with children. She tells the same story differently every time.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Winifred tells stories on her doorstep every evening, and half the children of the old quarters grew up on them. She knows all four peoples' tales of the Balrog and refuses to say which she believes.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Simkin: husband
  • Gytha: daughter
  • Hodge: grandson

docs.title: Wulfric
docs.text:
Vault Warden

Town Selsior Where Royal Vault Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Huge, quiet and soft-spoken. He blushes when thanked.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Wulfric guards the vault doors beneath the palace and has never had to draw his sword there. He married the vault clerk after years of silently carrying her ledgers up the stairs.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Jocelyn: wife

docs.title: Wystan
docs.text:
Stablemaster

Town Selsior Where Knights' Court Role Worker Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grumbling, gentle with animals and rough with people. He trusts a horse's opinion over a captain's.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Wystan keeps the Guard's horses and has done for forty years. Horses come back from the roads jumpy and wild-eyed lately, and he wants to know what they are smelling out there.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Aylwin: grandson

docs.title: Edgar Penhallow
docs.text:
Guild Apprentice from Selsior

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Polite, earnest and slowly loosening up. Edgar still says please to doors.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Edgar's guild in Selsior sent him to study Urbanograd's workshops for a season, and he has filled four notebooks. He is beginning to suspect he does not want to go back, and has not written home about it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rivet: friend
  • Cobble: unimpressed teacher

docs.title: Bastian 'Bellows' Krell
docs.text:
Loudest Voice at the Table

Town Urbanograd Where Great Hall Role Council Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Enormous voice, enormous opinions, enormous heart. He changes his mind loudly and without shame.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bastian has spoken at every Open Table for twenty years and has never once been short. This year he is campaigning, at length, for a covered bridge over Lantern Square so the night market can run in the rain.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rook: patient listener
  • Mags: wife

docs.title: Bolt
docs.text:
Tinker's Apprentice

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Eager, clumsy and full of ideas that almost work. Bolt apologizes to every machine he breaks.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Bolt is Margo's apprentice and does most of the sweeping and all of the testing. He secretly thinks some of Rivet's ideas are better than Margo's and is afraid to say so.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Margo 'Sparks' Venn: mentor

docs.title: Brindle
docs.text:
Captain of the Gate Watch

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Steady, plain-spoken and dryly funny. Brindle believes in good boots, good lanterns and checking twice.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Brindle commands the small volunteer watch that guards the old fortress gate. Brindle has asked the Open Table for more volunteers this year, because monsters now come closer to the walls than they used to.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Knox: guard
  • Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe: guard
  • Rook: friend

docs.title: Cobble
docs.text:
Bootmaker

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Elder Sells Boots, rooftop slippers and repairs

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Grumpy, honest and proud. Cobble says a boot should outlive its owner and means it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Cobble makes the soft-soled boots that rooftop runners swear by, and has made them for three generations of Kites. He wants an apprentice but has rejected every one so far for having the wrong sort of hands.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Kite: loyal customer
  • Edgar Penhallow: would-be apprentice

docs.title: Crow
docs.text:
Tonic Seller

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Healing tonics, mana draughts and remedies

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Ivo Sable: exasperated colleague

docs.title: Crumb
docs.text:
Baker from the Farmlands

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Bread, rolls and sweet buns

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Remy Marlo: fellow newcomer
  • Rue: friend from the farmlands

docs.title: Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe
docs.text:
Night Watch Guard

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Guard Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Jumpy, sharp-eyed and talkative to fight off the dark. She carries two lamps because one went out once.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dagny keeps the gate on the night watch and has seen eyes in the dark beyond the road more often this year than last. She is braver than she thinks and has not noticed yet.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Brindle: captain
  • Patch: healer

docs.title: Dex
docs.text:
Plays the Grandee

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: A born clown with a booming voice and an ego to match, but generous with every laugh he gets.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dex has played the pompous grandee in Juna's play for fifteen years and knows every line of every part. He wants to try a serious role just once, and nobody will take him seriously.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dina Finch: director
  • Sprout: son

docs.title: Dimity 'Inkpot' Ash
docs.text:
Scribe of the Open Table

Town Urbanograd Where Great Hall Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Precise, ink-stained and secretly delighted by every argument. She writes down the jokes as carefully as the decisions.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dimity has kept the Table's record for twelve years, and her shelves hold every heckle and every vote. She is quietly worried that the oldest record books, from the first winters, are crumbling and nobody has copied them.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rook: colleague at the Table
  • Ozzie Lantry: fellow keeper of records

docs.title: Wendel 'Dog-Ear' Tuck
docs.text:
Seller of Old Books and Banned Plays

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Second-hand books, play scripts and song sheets

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Ozzie Lantry: frustrated would-be buyer

docs.title: Drum
docs.text:
Bucket Drummer

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Says almost nothing and lets the rhythm talk. Drum smiles only when someone in the crowd starts dancing.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Drum plays a ring of upturned buckets and pans every evening, and the night market sets its pace by the beat. Drum is trying to work out a rhythm loud enough to keep monsters away from the roads, half as a joke and half not.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Jinx: street partner
  • Saffi: bandmate

docs.title: Dyna
docs.text:
Tailor of Loud Clothes

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Sells Patchwork coats, bright scarves and stage clothes

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Thimble: haggling customer

docs.title: Ferro
docs.text:
Smith of Odd Metals

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Daggers, throwing stars, claws and knuckle guards

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gruff, exacting and secretly sentimental. Ferro names every blade before it leaves the forge.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ferro used to make only metal sculptures, but with the roads getting worse the adventurers keep asking for weapons, so now Ferro makes those too and grumbles about it. Ferro still welds a sculpture every Walkout Day and gives it away.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Shade: customer
  • Hatch: old customer

docs.title: Figgy
docs.text:
Chalk Artist

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Bright, bossy and stubborn, with chalk dust up to the elbows. Figgy insists every drawing is finished only when it rains.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ochre's daughter draws on every flagstone in the square and charges passers-by one copper to step on her pictures. She wants a real wall of her own.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Jinx: favorite audience
  • Ochre: mother

docs.title: Glim
docs.text:
Paper Lantern Seller

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Paper lanterns and candle stubs

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Moth: father
  • Saucer: adopted grandparent

docs.title: Hambone
docs.text:
Keeper of the Theatre Cart

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Worker Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sentimental, stubborn and a very bad liar. Hambone polishes the cart wheels while humming the play's songs.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hambone looks after the old cart the troupe performs on every Walkout Day, and swears some of its planks come from Juna's own cart. One wheel is cracking, and he cannot bear to replace it.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Thimble: old friend
  • Pip Marrow: friend

docs.title: Hatch
docs.text:
Monster Hunter

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Adventurer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Weathered, blunt and full of stories he tells only after the second cup. Hatch trusts his nose more than any map.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hatch has hunted on Veligor's roads for thirty years and says the monsters today are nothing like the ones of his youth. He is too old to go out alone now and is looking for someone worth teaching.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ferro: smith
  • Tick: admirer
  • Shade: former pupil

docs.title: Hex
docs.text:
Puzzle-Box Maker

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Puzzle boxes, locks and clever latches

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sly, playful and secretive. Hex answers every question with a riddle unless you are buying something.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Hex builds boxes that open only for the right sequence of taps and turns. One of Hex's earliest boxes was sold years ago and has come back unopened with a note saying the buyer could not solve it, and Hex cannot remember the trick either.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Velvet: friend

docs.title: Ozzie Lantry
docs.text:
Historian of the Walkers

Town Urbanograd Where Great Hall Role Scholar Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Gentle, rambling and easily sidetracked by a good anecdote. He keeps three pairs of spectacles and can never find any of them.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ozzie collects letters, diaries and songs from the Walkers and their children, and is writing a history of Urbanograd's first hundred years. He is missing every account of the first winter and would pay well for anyone who finds one in an old attic.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dimity 'Inkpot' Ash: fellow keeper of records
  • Quint: old friend
  • Wendel 'Dog-Ear' Tuck: teasing bookseller

docs.title: Ivo Sable
docs.text:
Street Healer

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Healer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Unhurried, gentle and very hard to rattle. He talks to patients about music to take their minds off the stitches.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ivo runs a little clinic under an awning on the square, mostly patching up rooftop tumbles and burnt fingers. More and more of his patients are travelers hurt on the roads, and he is running short of the bandages and salves that come in from outside.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Crow: stubborn colleague
  • Patch: fellow healer
  • Tinder: frequent patient

docs.title: Jinx
docs.text:
Juggler of Lantern Square

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Restless, cheeky and terrible at keeping secrets. Jinx drops things on purpose to make children laugh, and almost never by accident.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Jinx juggles anything handed over, from apples to Margo's spare parts, and passes the hat afterwards. The dream is to juggle burning torches on top of the theatre cart on Walkout Day, which the troupe has firmly refused so far.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Drum: street partner
  • Figgy: favorite juggler
  • Tinder: friend

docs.title: Hester 'Ladle' Cray
docs.text:
Skewer Seller

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Grilled skewers, pepper buns and hot cider

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Moth: friend
  • Scrap: grateful friend
  • Remy Marlo: stall neighbour

docs.title: Remy Marlo
docs.text:
Smoked Fish Seller

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Smoked fish, sea-salt crisps and pickled kelp

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Crumb: fellow newcomer
  • Hester 'Ladle' Cray: stall neighbour

docs.title: Kite
docs.text:
Rooftop Runner

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Worker Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fast, boastful and impossible to keep on the ground. Kite talks while running and never runs out of breath.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Kite carries messages across the city by rooftop and holds the record for the run from the Gate Walk to the Great Hall. Kite's mother and grandmother were runners too and all wore Cobble's boots.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Cobble: bootmaker
  • Splash: sweetheart

docs.title: Knox
docs.text:
Gate Watch Guard

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Guard Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Big, gentle and slow to anger. Knox carves little wooden animals during quiet watches.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Knox has guarded the gate for ten years and knows every regular traveler by face. He would like his son Tick to choose a safer life and is losing that argument.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Brindle: captain
  • Tick: son

docs.title: Lux
docs.text:
Keeper of the Lanterns

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Calm, watchful and fond of heights. Lux speaks softly and notices every lantern that has gone out.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Lux climbs the towers every dusk to relight the lanterns strung between them, a job that has passed through a dozen hands since the Walkers hung the first ones. Lately some of the lanterns facing the wilds have been found smashed in the mornings, and Lux would like to know by what.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tinsel: glass supplier
  • Perch: friend
  • Prism: friend

docs.title: Mags
docs.text:
Cook of the Great Hall

Town Urbanograd Where Great Hall Role Service Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brisk and bossy in the kitchen, soft as bread dough everywhere else. She judges people by whether they wash their own bowl.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Mags feeds the Open Table, which can run until dawn, from one huge pot of stew that she claims has never been fully emptied since her grandmother's day. She would like someone to invent a stove that does not smoke.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rook: grateful regular
  • Bastian 'Bellows' Krell: husband
  • Old Parsnip: vegetable supplier

docs.title: Margo 'Sparks' Venn
docs.text:
Inventor of Sparking Things

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Adult Sells Gadgets, spring-traps and sparking lamps

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brilliant, scatterbrained and slightly singed. Margo explains every invention three ways before she lets anyone touch it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Margo's workshop is the one with the smoke stains around the door. She is building a lamp that throws sparks to frighten off road monsters, and needs someone brave enough to test it outside the walls.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Bolt: apprentice
  • Rivet: rival
  • Zinnia 'Zip' Calloway: gadget tester

docs.title: Moth
docs.text:
Keeper of the Night Market Stalls

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Role Official Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Wry, tireless and allergic to mornings. Moth knows which stall is where by smell alone.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Moth assigns the stalls each evening by drawing names from a hat, the way the first traders did, so no one owns the best corner for long. Moth has noticed fewer traders arriving from outside since the roads turned dangerous and worries about the winter.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Glim: daughter
  • Hester 'Ladle' Cray: friend

docs.title: Nana Gristle
docs.text:
Bench-Sitter of Lantern Square

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Resident Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Sharp-tongued, sweet-toothed and impossible to shock. She knows everyone's grandparents and all their embarrassing stories.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Nana Gristle's mother was carried out of Selsior in a basket on the day of the Long Walk, and Nana treats this as the city's most important fact. She sits on the same bench every day and tells newcomers which rooftops to avoid.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rook: fond listener
  • Saucer: old friend

docs.title: Nix
docs.text:
Mask Maker

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Masks, face paint and Walkout Day costumes

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Velvet: friend
  • Pip Marrow: model

docs.title: Ochre
docs.text:
Muralist

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Craftsman Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Big-hearted and messy, always speckled with paint. Ochre talks to walls as if they were old friends.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Ochre has painted half the walls around the square and repaints the oldest ones every spring so the Walkers' first pictures never fade. Ochre wants to paint the whole history of the city along the Gate Walk but cannot get enough red paint.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Figgy: daughter
  • Splash: rival painter

docs.title: Dina Finch
docs.text:
Director of the Old Barracks Troupe

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Performer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Commanding, theatrical and warm under the bluster. Dina gives notes even at breakfast.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dina runs the troupe that performs Juna Marrow's play on a cart every Walkout Day, as it was first performed. She is determined that this year's play will be the funniest in a decade, and she has said so every year for a decade.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Pip Marrow: protégée
  • Dex: lead actor
  • Piper: songwriter
  • Rue: lead actress
  • Quint: opening speaker

docs.title: Old Parsnip
docs.text:
Rooftop Gardener

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Worker Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Slow, earthy and stubbornly hopeful. Old Parsnip talks to seedlings and swears they listen.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Old Parsnip grows vegetables in tubs and troughs across the rooftops, a habit the city picked up after the Walkers nearly starved their first winter. With fewer food carts arriving, more people are asking him for seeds.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Perch: rooftop neighbour
  • Mags: customer

docs.title: Patch
docs.text:
Herbalist of the Gate Walk

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Healer Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Brusque, practical and quietly tender. Patch scolds patients while bandaging them.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Patch tends the travelers who stumble in through the gate with monster bites and scrapes. Her herb supplies come from outside the walls, and she needs someone to gather fresh ones now that the fields are risky.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ivo Sable: fellow healer
  • Dagny 'Two-Lamps' Roe: friend

docs.title: Perch
docs.text:
Pigeon Keeper

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Resident Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Soft-spoken, patient and covered in feathers. Perch understands birds better than people and admits it.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Perch keeps message pigeons in a loft on the highest roof in the city. Over the last few years the birds have begun refusing certain routes over the wilds, and Perch keeps a careful list of which ones.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Lux: friend
  • Pounce: uninvited lodger
  • Old Parsnip: rooftop neighbour
  • Starling: friend

docs.title: Pip Marrow
docs.text:
Juna's Great-Granddaughter

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Witty, self-doubting and quick with a comeback. Pip hates being introduced by her surname.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Pip is descended from Juna Marrow, and everyone expects her to write a play as good as Juna's. She has written three and burned two, and she is secretly working on a new comedy she will not show anyone.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dina Finch: mentor
  • Hambone: keeper of her ancestor's cart
  • Nix: mask maker

docs.title: Piper
docs.text:
Songwriter of the Troupe

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Romantic, scatterbrained and always humming something new. Piper falls in love with a melody a week.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Piper writes new songs for the play every year, to Dina's despair and the crowd's delight. Piper wants to play with Saffi but is too shy to ask.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Saffi: admired musician
  • Dina Finch: exasperated director

docs.title: Pounce
docs.text:
Rooftop Cat

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Animal Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Lazy by day, dignified by night and certain that every roof belongs to him.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Pounce is a big grey cat who sleeps in Perch's pigeon loft, which the pigeons have accepted with deep reluctance. Rooftop folk say he always knows when the weather is about to turn.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Perch: keeper
  • Rue: rehearsal partner

docs.title: Prism
docs.text:
Light-Painter from the Forest

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Curious, earnest and delighted by everything. Prism asks questions faster than anyone can answer them.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Prism grew up in the forest learning a little magic and came to Urbanograd to use it for art, painting pictures with small lights in the air for travelers arriving at the gate. Prism hopes to put on a light show for Walkout Day.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Lux: friend

docs.title: Quint
docs.text:
Keeper of the Charter Scroll

Town Urbanograd Where Great Hall Role Official Age Elder

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Solemn about exactly one thing, the Open Charter, and cheerfully unserious about everything else.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Quint guards the hall's copy of the Open Charter ruling and reads it aloud every Walkout Day morning before the play. He likes to remind young hotheads that the kingdom chose to welcome the Walkers, and that this is worth being proud of.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rook: friend
  • Ozzie Lantry: old friend
  • Dina Finch: director

docs.title: Rivet
docs.text:
Builder of the Rooftop Lift

Town Urbanograd Where Workshops Row Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cocky, competitive and very practical. Rivet would rather build something that works than something that sparkles.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rivet built the rope-and-pulley lift that hauls crates up to the Rooftops and wants to build a second one, if the Open Table agrees. Rivet and Margo argue about everything and would both be lost without each other.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Margo 'Sparks' Venn: rival
  • Edgar Penhallow: admirer
  • Vane: partner on rooftop projects

docs.title: Rook
docs.text:
Caller of the Open Table

Town Urbanograd Where Great Hall Role Ruler Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Dry, patient and quick to laugh, with a voice that can cut through a shouting hall without ever sounding angry. Rook hates making speeches and loves listening to them.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: The Open Table chose Rook as this year's Caller, which means convening the Table, keeping order and making sure the quiet ones get a turn; it does not mean ruling anyone, and Rook reminds people of that often. Rook keeps up a long, warm exchange of letters with the capital and reads the funniest parts aloud at the Table.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Dimity 'Inkpot' Ash: colleague at the Table
  • Bastian 'Bellows' Krell: favorite heckler
  • Quint: old friend and adviser
  • Mags: friend
  • Saucer: tea seller
  • Nana Gristle: scolding elder
  • Brindle: captain who reports to the Table
  • Aveline: frequent correspondent

docs.title: Rue
docs.text:
Plays Juna on Walkout Day

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Quiet, observant and stricken with stage fright until the very moment she steps on. Then she is fearless.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Rue came to the city from Kaldemor's farmlands three years ago and won the part of Juna this spring, to everyone's surprise including her own. She practices her lines on Pounce, who is not much help.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Crumb: friend from the farmlands
  • Dina Finch: director
  • Pounce: unimpressed audience

docs.title: Saffi
docs.text:
Fiddler of Lantern Square

Town Urbanograd Where Lantern Square Role Performer Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Fierce, fast and impatient with anything slow, including her own fingers. She laughs at her own mistakes before anyone else can.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Saffi came from a family of respectable musicians who wanted her to play slow court dances, so she plays everything twice as fast. She is writing a tune for every street in the city and has finished nine.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Piper: admirer
  • Drum: bandmate

docs.title: Saucer
docs.text:
Tea Stall Keeper

Town Urbanograd Where Night Market Sells Spiced tea, honey cakes and fortune leaves

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Rook: regular customer
  • Nana Gristle: old friend
  • Glim: helper

docs.title: Scrap
docs.text:
Rooftop Scamp

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Nimble, nosy and fearless in all the wrong places. Scrap collects lost things and gives them names.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Scrap is Vane's daughter and has never once used the stairs. She wants to be an adventurer like Shade and practices sneaking on everyone.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Hester 'Ladle' Cray: secret feeder
  • Vane: mother
  • Shade: hero

docs.title: Shade
docs.text:
Knife-Thrower and Road Guide

Town Urbanograd Where Gate Walk Role Adventurer Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Cool, quiet and secretly soft on children. Shade never misses and never brags.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Shade guides travelers and traders safely along the roads into the city, for a fee and a hot meal. The routes Shade trusted a few years ago are not safe anymore, and Shade is looking for new ones.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ferro: smith
  • Scrap: admirer
  • Hatch: old mentor

docs.title: Splash
docs.text:
Night Painter

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Craftsman Age Young

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Restless, playful and allergic to permission. Splash never signs a painting and never stops grinning.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Splash paints murals on the backs of chimneys and the undersides of bridges overnight, where only rooftop folk can see them. Splash wants to paint something that can be seen from the Gate Walk, so travelers know they have arrived.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Ochre: rival painter
  • Kite: sweetheart

docs.title: Sprout
docs.text:
Troupe Urchin

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Child Age Child

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Giggly, loud and never still. Sprout has learned every part in the play by accident.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Dex's son plays the market urchin who cheers for Juna in the first scene, and he steals the show every year. He wants to play the grandee one day so he can wear the hat.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text: • Dex: father

docs.title: Starling
docs.text:
Rooftop Stargazer

Town Urbanograd Where Rooftops Role Scholar Age Adult

docs.title: Personality
docs.text: Distracted, kind and wildly enthusiastic about anything in the sky. Starling sleeps through every afternoon.

docs.title: Story
docs.text: Starling maps the stars from a telescope built out of Tinsel's spare lenses. On some nights the horizon toward the middle of the island seems to flicker, and Starling has started writing down the dates without knowing what they mean.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
• Tinsel: lens maker
  • Perch: friend

docs.title: Thimble
docs.text:
Costume Maker

Town Urbanograd Where Old Barracks Theatre Role Craftsman Age Elder
